$Comment: PvP queue policy for the clash_1v1 preset. AllowSolo false (a duel needs two); the Solo card is disabled so players queue Public (matched with a stranger) or Party (premade). Team size and win condition come from the round preset with the id clash_1v1 (its TeamSize and WinCondition), which a pack may author under KweebecNightmare/Presets; with none loaded, the match runs on the nightmare preset's values. This file is only the queue and menu layer.
